long: MyHouse.wad is a 2023 horror modification for Doom II, built for the GZDoom source port. Disguised as an ordinary recreation of the author's childhood home, it gradually warps into a non-euclidean nightmare of shifting, impossible architecture. The mod became famous for its unsettling level design and hidden narrative layers.
name: MyHouse.wad
short: MyHouse.wad (Veddge 2023, non-euclidean horror mod; myhouse.pk3 + DOOM2.WAD via GZDoom)
